takeaways: The strongest unused material is the /Friend backyard photo set: soft-light, mature finished shots of a fire-bowl patio, slab paths and hydrangea beds (cells 95, 93, 101, 107). It should become the Sylvan case-study gallery and a work-index cover alternative. The same project also exists as a 3D design walkthrough (day.wmv/night.wmv in 'B&A- Friend (Backyard Renvation)'), so the case study could show render vs. finished build, though the 640x480 renders need to stay small. Mock.mp4 is the only finished, polished Sylvan ad: it proves service:digital-advertising and belongs on the case study (confirm it is final, since the file is named 'Mock'). For the hero loop, Johns House's fire close-up (1:45), Wolf's red-shovel crew shot (0:52) and the Grasinger drone orbit (0:04) are clean, text-free new motion. The 85 Crawford homeowner interview (three 5:22 angles, 4K) is raw but is the only client-testimonial source here and is worth cutting for the case study.
